description: Java source code for a QR Code generator demo, demonstrating QR code creation, segmentation, masking, and output to PNG and SVG files.

classes.name: QrCodeGeneratorDemo
classes.description: Main class demonstrating QR code generation and output.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main application entry point, runs various QR code demos.

methods.name: doBasicDemo
methods.description: Creates a simple QR code with 'Hello, world!' and outputs PNG and SVG files.

methods.name: doVarietyDemo
methods.description: Generates multiple QR codes with different data and error correction levels.

methods.name: doSegmentDemo
methods.description: Demonstrates QR code encoding with segmented data for better compactness.

methods.name: doMaskDemo
methods.description: Creates QR codes with different mask patterns for comparison.

methods.name: writePng
methods.description: Utility to write BufferedImage to PNG file.
